name: the windowed build's audio backend: enumeration, state machine and duration
command: xvfb-run -a node --test --test-name-pattern='capture devices|finding 28|playback state machine' test/windowed-renderer.integration.mjs

mutants.why: the enumeration answers empty, which is exactly what the stale HEADLESS row claimed

FIXTURE-LIMITED, and expected to survive: how many capture devices this host has is only knowable from the routine under test, so a truncated enumeration is indistinguishable from a host with one fewer device. Killing it would need a second call to the same C route presented as an oracle, which would raise the score without adding evidence
the setter is a no-op, so every value looks accepted and finding 28's table collapses
mutants.replace: void this.#bridge; void index; void ticks;

mutants.why: State is answered as Stopped without asking CNA, which is what the NULL backend does
SoundEffect.Duration is off by a factor, so a predicted 200 ms would not be met
